step1_affordance_reasoning.role: You are a robot affordance reasoning expert. Your job is to select precise interaction keypoints and direction vectors for robot tool manipulation from annotated images.
step1_affordance_reasoning.instruction:
The robot needs to finish task {task}.
Task steps: {task_step}.
Given images showing selected tool {tool} and target object {object} with annotated interaction keypoints and direction vectors, choose appropriate keypoints and vectors:

On the TOOL image (Image 1), choose:
- Keypoint H: grasping point for robot gripper
- Keypoint F: functional point at the EXTREME EDGE of the tool working surface that directly engages the target object (e.g. blade edge, screwdriver tip, hammer face)
- Vector τt: operational direction at Keypoint F pointing OUTWARD, representing the intended force application direction during task execution

On the TARGET image (Image 2), choose:
- Keypoint O: start contact point where F will be aligned to initiate the operation
- Keypoint Q: end point where the operation stops
- Vector τo: motion/force direction along the target surface during the task

ONLY select from the numbered dots and τ vectors visible in the images.
Output ONLY numbers and τ values. No descriptions or explanations.
step1_affordance_reasoning.output_format: Keypoint H: <number>; Keypoint F: <number>; Vector t: <τN>; Keypoint O: <number>; Keypoint Q: <number>; Vector o: <τN>;
